title: Closed-component retraction for an algebra map identifying stalks
statement: Let R and S be commutative rings with R and S w-local [def-weil-pbc-w-local], equipped with an R-algebra structure on S. Assume the algebra map R \to S induces bijections on all prime stalks [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], and every closed point of Spec S contracts to a closed point of Spec R. Let T be a closed subset of the connected-component space π₀(Spec S). If the map π₀(Spec S) \to π₀(Spec R) induced by contraction is surjective and injective on T (equivalently, its restriction to T is bijective), then there exists a ring map f:S\to R with f\circ(R\to S)=\mathrm{id}_R.
